issues.finding: First EXE candidate exceeded the 700 ms p95 sampling limit during concurrent Android compilation (738.3 ms).
issues.resolution: Kept the threshold, preserved failed evidence and verified the final executable with the owned emulator stopped.

issues.finding: Android Activity recreation overlapped first SQLite initialization; ready could precede the first packet.
issues.resolution: Serialized Mobile construction and set readiness after packet generation; concurrent initialization test and signed-APK execution pass.

issues.finding: Fresh PyPI Qt under Anaconda loaded an incompatible ICU DLL.
issues.resolution: PE imports/exports identified the collision; the installed entry point loads Windows ICU by absolute path for the PyPI layout only. Existing environments and global PATH were not modified.

issues.finding: Cross-platform verification initially omitted OBSERVED fixtures and used an observed-only readback on mixed history.
issues.resolution: Included a genuine ARX observation and compared all retained classes. Nine desktop events and 149 Android events retain their exact event bodies.

issues.finding: An early system-picker download occurred before asynchronous export completed.
issues.resolution: Read back the completed 159-event file; Android imported it through the actual system picker.

issues.finding: The API 37 emulator showed System UI ANRs during boot before ATOMVERSE launch.
issues.resolution: Allocated four virtual cores / 4 GiB in the owned AVD, stabilized System UI and then executed the signed ARM64 APK. Physical-device coverage remains unavailable.
